module_summary: 10GBASE-R PHY transmit interface: scrambles 64b/66b encoded data with a 58-bit LFSR or substitutes PRBS31 test pattern, registering output to SERDES with optional bit-reverse and pipeline.

anchors.name: encoded_tx_data
anchors.why: 64-bit encoded payload input fed to the scrambler LFSR

anchors.name: encoded_tx_hdr
anchors.why: 2-bit sync header input passed unscrambled to output register

anchors.name: serdes_tx_data
anchors.why: 64-bit data output to SERDES after scrambling and optional pipeline

anchors.name: cfg_tx_prbs31_enable
anchors.why: Selects PRBS31 test pattern instead of scrambled data for output registers

anchors.name: scrambler_state_reg
anchors.why: 58-bit scrambler LFSR state register updated every cycle

anchors.name: scrambled_data
anchors.why: Scrambler output data loaded into serdes data register

anchors.name: prbs31_state_reg
anchors.why: 31-bit PRBS31 generator LFSR state, only active when PRBS31_ENABLE

anchors.name: prbs31_data
anchors.why: 66-bit PRBS31 pattern, inverted into data and header registers

anchors.name: serdes_tx_data_reg
anchors.why: Output data register choosing scrambled, raw, or PRBS data each cycle

anchors.name: serdes_tx_hdr_reg
anchors.why: Output header register from encoded header or PRBS bits

groups.name: Scrambler
groups.description: 58-bit self-synchronous LFSR scrambler over encoded data

groups.name: Output register and select
groups.description: Selects PRBS or scrambled data, registers, optional bit-reverse and pipeline
